primaryMetaphor: Small glowing comment balls flowing into memory bucket, with winner selection through dice rolling
visualContinuity: Memory bucket container persists and transforms throughout all scenes, from empty to overflowing to single-winner to multi-winner challenge

scenes.name: The Scenario Setup

keySync.visualEvent: Comment balls multiply exponentially, creating digital rain effect

scenes.visual: Live stream interface at screen top with small glowing cyan comment balls (#00f5d4) beginning to fall from top like digital rain. Rectangular memory bucket sits at bottom center, initially manageable size. Clean typography displays 'GIVEAWAY SYSTEM' title. Balls have subtle glow and physics-based movement.
scenes.connectsTo: Comments begin overwhelming the bucket capacity

scenes.name: The Memory Crisis

keySync.visualEvent: Memory bucket shows stress cracks and begins overflowing with warning indicators

scenes.visual: Comment balls pour faster and denser. Memory bucket expands but shows stress cracks in magenta (#f72585). Red warning indicators flash around edges. Overflow animation shows balls spilling around base. 'MEMORY OVERFLOW' text flashes urgently. Physics show bucket struggling under load.
scenes.buildsFrom: Manageable comment stream becomes uncontrollable flood

scenes.name: The Solution Reveal

keySync.visualEvent: Algorithm name materializes with elegant typography, screen transitions to minimal clean design

scenes.visual: Screen clears to minimal dark background (#0a0a0f). Single clean rectangular bucket appears center with just ONE glowing golden winner ball (#feca57) inside. 'RESERVOIR SAMPLING' materializes with elegant typography. Subtitle 'One variable. Infinite fairness.' appears below. Golden winner ball pulses gently.
scenes.buildsFrom: Chaos resolves into simple, clean solution

scenes.name: Algorithm Mechanics

keySync.visualEvent: 3D dice materializes and rolls showing probability calculation

scenes.visual: [3D REQUIRED] Step-by-step demonstration. New cyan comment ball approaches from top. 3D dice materializes with realistic lighting and rolls, showing '1/n' on faces. Based on dice result, either new ball smoothly replaces current golden winner or bounces off bucket. Process repeats with increasing n values displayed. Probability formula '1/n' updates dynamically.
scenes.buildsFrom: Abstract algorithm becomes concrete mechanical process

scenes.name: Mathematical Fairness Proof

keySync.visualEvent: Both first and millionth commenter balls glow with identical synchronized pulses

scenes.visual: Split screen showing two identical glowing comment balls - one labeled '1st COMMENTER' on left, one labeled '1,000,000th COMMENTER' on right. Mathematical formula 'P = 1/n' appears between them in clean typography. Both balls pulse with identical golden light frequency in perfect synchronization, proving equal probability.
scenes.buildsFrom: Algorithm mechanics lead to proof of fairness

scenes.name: The Challenge

keySync.visualEvent: Single winner bucket transforms and expands to show 5 distinct winner slots

scenes.visual: The single-winner bucket smoothly transforms, expanding horizontally to show 5 distinct compartments for winners. Large animated question mark appears above bucket. Multiple cyan comment balls approach from different angles simultaneously. Challenge text 'THE CHALLENGE: 5 Winners, Same Rules?' appears prominently.
scenes.buildsFrom: Mastered single-winner concept gets complexity added

scenes.name: Call to Action

keySync.visualEvent: Checkmark icon appears with golden glow, solution prompt materializes

scenes.visual: Clean minimal design with dark background. [ICON: checkmark] glows in golden center with subtle pulsing animation. 'Share Your Solution' text appears in elegant typography. Presenter information 'Prasanna - Technical Architect at Zoho' slides up from bottom. Subscribe and follow prompts appear in corners with gentle animations.
scenes.buildsFrom: Technical challenge evolves into social participation
